adaptation.name: bounded_three_step_prediction_lookahead
adaptation.start: first interval boundary strictly after optimizer warmup
adaptation.hold_rule: hold current p unless another candidate clears both conditions
adaptation.probe_batch_size: 16 when maximum training target length exceeds 128, otherwise 32; capped at one sixth of the training set
adaptation.sampling: independent persistent RNG, six mutually disjoint training-only batches sampled without replacement per probe; three update and three score
adaptation.candidate_update: three sequential clipped AdamW updates at current learning rate and current moments; identical update batches and initial dropout RNG for every candidate
adaptation.criterion: mean ordinary one-pass label-smoothed CE over three identical scoring batches for every candidate, dropout off
adaptation.restore: model, optimizer, gradients, mode flags, Python/Torch/device RNG; discard all hypothetical updates
